ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface area interspersed with high-intensity (white) localized pixel clusters; estimated ratio of 85:15 black to white pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive distribution of high-contrast white circular and ring-shaped blobs across a dark ventral background. Higher density of these features is mapped to the distal and medial regions of the right lobe compared to the left.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible central V-shaped depression with a wide angle; depth is approximately 15% of total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations present along the entire trailing edge; several larger, deeper notches (higher amplitude) visible on the distal third of the left lobe and the tip of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature fitting the trailing edges of both lobes, transitioning to a slight convexity at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of roughly circular white rings (barnacle scars) distributed across both lobes; major concentration on the right lobe forming an almost contiguous white patch at the distal end.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several short, unaligned white linear pixel streaks detected on the medial portion of the left lobe and near the center of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring across the ventral surface; irregular, frayed appearance at the distal tips of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme density of circular scarring on the right lobe tip creates a unique, nearly solid high-intensity visual marker.
